title: Ortofon 2M Bronze — 1 kHz Reference Check
source_report_title: Thorens TD160 Super - SME iII - Ortofon 2M Bronze - Art

harmonic_reliability.quality_note: The left channel’s overall distortion changed most during recording. The report recommends repeating the capture before further cartridge setup changes.

interpretation.summary: The Ortofon 2M Bronze averaged 32.2 dB of separation at 1 kHz on the vintage Thorens TD 160 Super and SME III. The final capture recorded a 1.72 dB difference between crosstalk directions and +0.44 dB left-minus-right output balance. Playback averaged 33.30 RPM with 0.028% DIN-shaped wow and flutter RMS.
interpretation.recommendation: Repeat the capture before using the distortion readings to guide further cartridge setup changes. The report found that the left channel’s overall distortion varied most.
interpretation.rotation_context: Both speed fingerprints show a faster section near the start and end of the displayed angular scale and a slower section near the middle across eight rotations. The cause of the pattern was not established.

session_observations.source: Measurer account supplied with publication request

anti_skate_adjustment.observation: The measurer reported a significant improvement after adjusting anti-skate.

provenance.data_entry_method: Numerical results from the final capture were transcribed from the original PDF and checked against its rendered page. Reported differences preserve source precision. The initial imbalance and adjustment observations come from the measurer’s session account.
provenance.raw_audio_note: No raw test-record audio is included.
provenance.setup_metadata_source: The report title and measurer identify the Thorens TD 160 Super, SME III, Ortofon 2M Bronze and ART preamp. The report does not identify the capture input.
known_limitations: The 5.86 dB initial imbalance is a measurer-reported observation with no specified metric. The final report separately gives output balance and the difference between crosstalk directions.

The ART preamp model, capture-device model, tracking force, final azimuth and anti-skate settings, alignment geometry, loading, test record and track, capture settings, repeat count and software versions were not recorded.
The results describe the playback chain as captured. The individual contributions of the cartridge, tonearm, turntable, test record and electronics were not isolated.
provenance.fingerprint_channel_assignment: Channel assignments follow the supplied filenames. Each fingerprint shows eight rotations. The angular reference between captures is unspecified.
provenance.photo_treatment: The archived source is a full-resolution 4032 × 3024 JPEG from the supplied HEIC with embedded metadata stripped. The separate ImageGen edit adjusts lighting and white balance, reduces glare and cleans up dust.
